data.text: I am the best person you can recruit for this career. I grew up with news all the day I looked up with truth! In my last job I wrote tech column, but It was being tiring for me. I want satisfy or meet my wishes to get a new opportunity. I learned about this career from my father and he leaned from his father and this loop is permanent, so, be a reporter is in my blood. My reason is my commitment to every people who live in this neghiboor, they deserve to know the truth. I am strict man about news, I do not plateau on a same level I interest to know everything!
